name: HYROX Lab
subtitle: WHOOP-powered HYROX, running and readiness — on your own phone.
description: Personal AltStore / SideStore source for HYROX Lab, a fork of NOOP that adds a HYROX training system, a full running module and readiness coaching on top of NOOP's direct WHOOP connection. Add this source once; every new build appears as an update.

apps.name: HYROX Lab
apps.subtitle: HYROX, running and readiness from your WHOOP.
apps.localizedDescription: HYROX Lab reads a WHOOP strap you own directly over Bluetooth (via NOOP) and adds HYROX simulations and race mode, GPS running with splits and audio cues, readiness, training plans and a coach. Everything stays on the phone. Personal, non-commercial build; not affiliated with WHOOP or HYROX.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Records your route during outdoor runs.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Reads Apple Health data you authorise.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Writes workouts you authorise to Apple Health.
